title: DBC Import production UI
objective: Add the production caller for the DBC import boundary that already exists. A new DbcImportControl component renders an Import DBC action, enabled only when a project is open, and on activation calls the EXISTING importDbcFromNativeDialog(projectPath) orchestration - it does not re-implement the native file picker, Base64 handling, DBC parsing, the Runtime request or the Rust invoke. projectPath comes from the workspace session's opened project; the component never guesses one. On success it invalidates the TanStack Query asset collection for that EXACT projectPath so the list refetches - invalidateQueries with the same query key tuple the DBC workspace reads ({ queryKey: ['dbc', 'assets', projectPath] }) - and the newly imported asset then appears. A dismissed dialog is control flow, not an error: no invalidation, no error notice. Every failure is classified and rendered as a human-readable message - DbcFileBridgeError, RuntimeDbcApiError, RuntimeDbcTransportError, RuntimeDbcContractError - and a structured Runtime failure's stable code may be surfaced. The component never renders the raw response body, the Runtime URL or the selected file's path; only the asset's provenance basename may be shown. It renders strings only from the frozen i18n keys under the 'dbc.import.' prefix.
scope: The new DBC import control component and its vitest suite.
non_goals: Multi-file, drag-and-drop, or automatic selection of the imported asset
A second HTTP client, a second query cache, or any dbc-client change
Asset delete/rename/replace/dedup, the DBC editor, or any runtime/Rust/IPC change
acceptance_criteria: With no project open the action is disabled and no import is attempted; with a project open it calls importDbcFromNativeDialog with exactly the session's projectPath
On { status: 'cancelled' } nothing is invalidated and no failure is rendered
On success the asset collection query for exactly that projectPath is invalidated, and an asset list rendered from that query key refetches and shows the new asset

A DbcFileBridgeError, a RuntimeDbcApiError, a RuntimeDbcTransportError and a RuntimeDbcContractError are each classified and rendered as a distinct human-readable message, and a RuntimeDbcApiError's stable code is surfaced
No rendered output contains the selected file's path, the Runtime URL or a raw response body - including in the failure states
The component performs no direct invoke, no Base64 work, no parsing and no fetch of its own
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for the focused vitest run, pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint
Name every new test case and state the RED observation that preceded each new behaviour, including the query-invalidation observation that proves the list refetches
State explicitly that no integration surface (App.tsx, DockWorkspace.tsx, DbcWorkspace.tsx, workspace/**, i18n/**), no Rust file and no Runtime file was touched
